fullPassage: Life is a balancing act, and so is our sense of morality. Research suggests that when we view ourselves as morally deficient in one part of our lives, we search for moral actions that will balance out the scale. Maybe you know you should be recycling but just never get around to gathering up your glass, paper, and plastics in time for the recycling truck. One day you happen to be walking through a hardware store and notice a rack of energy-efficient light bulbs, and you instantly decide to buy twenty of them and change out every bulb in your house. The moral deficiency (not recycling) is, in your view, balanced by a moral action (installing energy-efficient bulbs). The problem is that the seesaw can also tip the other way: If we believe we are doing enough, morally speaking, then there's little reason to do more. The scale is already level.

② The Hidden Seesaw of Our Conscience(우리 양심의 숨은 시소): 도덕성을 시소에 비유해 한쪽 부족을 다른 선행으로 맞추려는 심리를 압축하므로 제목으로 적절해요. ← 정답

③ Energy-Efficient Living on a Budget(알뜰하게 에너지 효율적으로 살기): 전구 예시에만 매인 지엽적 제목이에요.

④ The Science of Weighing Right and Wrong(옳고 그름을 재는 과학): 본문은 과학이 아니라 심리 경향을 다뤄 과장된 제목이에요.
det.tip: 핵심 비유(seesaw)와 주제(conscience/moral balance)를 함께 담은 제목을 고르세요.

ch: The Hidden Seesaw of Our Conscience
The Science of Weighing Right and Wrong

questions.passage: Life is a balancing act, and so is our sense of morality. Research suggests that when we view ourselves as morally deficient in one part of our lives, we search for moral actions that will balance out the scale. Maybe you know you should be recycling but just never get around to gathering up your glass, paper, and plastics in time for the recycling truck. One day you happen to be walking through a hardware store and notice a rack of energy-efficient light bulbs, and you instantly decide to buy twenty of them and change out every bulb in your house. The moral deficiency (not recycling) is, in your view, balanced by a moral action (installing energy-efficient bulbs). The problem is that <u>the seesaw can also tip the other way</u>: If we believe we are doing enough, morally speaking, then there's little reason to do more. The scale is already level.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 밑줄 친 <u>the seesaw can also tip the other way</u>가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 밑줄 친 비유가 가리키는 의미를 추론하는 문항이에요.
det.analysis:
① feeling we have already done enough can reduce our effort to do more(이미 충분히 했다고 느끼면 더 하려는 노력이 줄 수 있다): 바로 뒤 문장 'If we believe we are doing enough ... little reason to do more'를 그대로 설명하므로 정답이에요. ← 정답

② doing one good deed guarantees many more good deeds will follow(한 번의 선행이 더 많은 선행을 보장한다): 본문은 오히려 선행이 줄어든다고 하므로 반대예요.

③ moral failures always outweigh our moral successes(도덕적 실패가 항상 성공보다 크다): 본문에 없는 내용이에요.

④ people genuinely enjoy balancing objects such as seesaws(사람들은 시소 같은 물건의 균형 잡기를 즐긴다): 비유를 글자 그대로 오해한 것이에요.
det.tip: 시소가 '반대로' 기운다 = 충분하다고 느껴 노력이 줄어드는 역작용을 뜻해요.

ch: feeling we have already done enough can reduce our effort to do more
doing one good deed guarantees many more good deeds will follow
moral failures always outweigh our moral successes
people genuinely enjoy balancing objects such as seesaws

questions.passage: Life is a balancing act, and so is our sense of morality. Research suggests that when we view ourselves as morally deficient in one part of our lives, we search for moral actions that will balance out the scale. Maybe you know you should be recycling but just never get around to gathering up your glass, paper, and plastics in time for the recycling truck. One day you happen to be walking through a hardware store and notice a rack of energy-efficient light bulbs, and you instantly decide to buy twenty of <u>them</u> and change out every bulb in your house. The moral deficiency (not recycling) is, in your view, balanced by a moral action (installing energy-efficient bulbs). The problem is that the seesaw can also tip the other way: If we believe we are doing enough, morally speaking, then there's little reason to do more. The scale is already level.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>them</u>이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 밑줄 친 them이 가리키는 대상을 찾는 문항이에요.
det.analysis:
본문 'notice a rack of energy-efficient light bulbs, and you instantly decide to buy twenty of them'에서 them은 바로 앞의 energy-efficient light bulbs(에너지 효율 전구들)를 가리켜요.

② 도덕적 잘못은 사는(buy) 대상이 아니에요.
③ 재활용 트럭은 구매 대상이 아니에요.
④ 선반(rack)이 아니라 선반 위의 전구를 산 것이에요.
det.tip: buy twenty of them에서 '사는' 대상 = 바로 앞의 전구들입니다.

Research suggests that when we view ourselves as morally deficient in one part of our lives, we search for moral actions that will balance out the scale. Maybe you know you should be recycling but just never get around to gathering up your glass, paper, and plastics in time for the recycling truck. One day you happen to be walking through a hardware store and notice a rack of energy-efficient light bulbs, and you instantly decide to buy twenty of them and __________. The moral deficiency (not recycling) is, in your view, balanced by a moral action (installing energy-efficient bulbs). questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: change out every bulb in your house(집의 모든 전구를 교체하다) — 도덕적 행동의 구체적 실행.
det.analysis:
❌ ① return the bulbs to the store(전구를 가게에 반품하다): 사서 보완 행동을 한다는 흐름과 반대예요.

✅ ② change out every bulb in your house: 'buy twenty of them and ___'에서 전구 스무 개를 사서 '집의 모든 전구를 교체한다'는 도덕적 행동의 실행이에요. ← 정답

❌ ③ donate the bulbs to a charity(전구를 자선단체에 기부하다): 본문에 없는 내용이에요.

❌ ④ hide the bulbs in the garage(전구를 차고에 숨기다): 보완 행동과 정반대예요.
det.tip: 스무 개를 사서 '집의 모든 전구를 교체' = 도덕적 행동(에너지 절약) 실행.

ch: return the bulbs to the store
change out every bulb in your house
donate the bulbs to a charity
hide the bulbs in the garage

questions.stem:
위 글의 내용을 바탕으로, 다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)

'우리는 우리 자신을 도덕적으로 부족하다고 여긴다.'

[조건]
(1) as, deficient, morally, ourselves, view, we 를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 우리 자신을 도덕적으로 부족하다고 여긴다는 문장.
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- we(주어): 우리는
- view A as B(동사구): A를 B로 여기다
- ourselves(목적어): 우리 자신을
- as morally deficient(보어): 도덕적으로 부족하다고
- 'view + 목적어 + as + 형용사' 구조로 '~을 …라고 여기다'를 만들어요.
det.tip: view A as B: view ourselves as morally deficient(우리 자신을 ~라고 여기다).

questions.wa: we view ourselves as morally deficient
accept: we view ourselves as morally deficient

questions.passage: Research suggests that when we view ourselves as morally deficient in one part of our lives, we search for moral actions that will balance out the scale. questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

... never get around to __________ (gather) up your glass, paper, and plastics ...

det.korean: gather를 동명사로 변형.
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'get around to ___'에서 여기의 to는 전치사예요. 전치사 뒤에는 명사나 동명사(-ing)가 와야 하므로 gather를 gathering(모으는 것)으로 바꿔 'get around to gathering(모으는 일에 착수하다)'을 만들어요.
det.tip: get around to 다음의 to는 전치사 → 동명사 gathering.

[조건]

det.korean: 우연히 철물점을 지나가게 된다는 문장.
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- you(주어): 당신은
- happen to + 동사(구문): 우연히 ~하게 되다
- be walking(진행형): 걸어가고 있다
- through a hardware store(전치사구): 철물점을 지나서
- 'happen to be + -ing'는 '우연히 ~하고 있다'를 나타내요.
det.tip: happen to be walking: '우연히 걸어가고 있다'(happen to + be -ing).

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하시오. (11단어, 영어로)

'우리는 저울의 균형을 맞출 도덕적 행동을 찾는다.'

[actions / balance / for / moral / out / scale / search / that / the / we / will]

det.korean: 저울의 균형을 맞출 도덕적 행동을 찾는다는 문장.
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- we search for ~(주어+동사): 우리는 ~을 찾는다
- moral actions(목적어): 도덕적 행동을
- that will balance out the scale(관계절): 저울의 균형을 맞출
- 관계대명사 that이 moral actions를 꾸며 '~을 맞출 행동'이라는 뜻을 만들어요.
det.tip: 선행사(moral actions) + that + 동사(will balance out) 관계절 순서로 배열하세요.

det.korean: 우리가 충분히 하고 있다고 믿는다면이라는 조건절.
